# Regions

This folder contains the administrative regions of Denmark evaluated in the national clinical quality reports for atrial fibrillation. Each page details a specific region's healthcare infrastructure, including its major hospitals and local health clusters, alongside its performance across national quality indicators such as anticoagulation treatment, echocardiography, and follow-up care. The data is drawn directly from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database reports, providing a comprehensive view of regional compliance with clinical standards and patient outcomes.

## Pages

- [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland — Midtjylland]] — Details the Central Denmark Region's high clinical performance in atrial fibrillation care, its network of hospitals like Aarhus Universitetshospital, and its compliance with national quality indicators.
- [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark — Syddanmark]] — Covers the Region of Southern Denmark's healthcare delivery across facilities like OUH Odense Universitetshospital, its health clusters, and its statistical outcomes for atrial fibrillation diagnostics and treatment.
